market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham is a well-established mid-table Premier League club with strong financial backing and a squad depth that makes relegation highly unlikely. Historically, teams of their profile are relegated very rarely (roughly 5-10% chance). The market’s 34.5% implied probability is inflated, likely due to short-term pessimism, and the true probability is below 10%.
evidence_points: West Ham finished 9th in 2023-24 and have not been in the relegation zone in recent years.
Club revenue and wage bill place them in the top half of the Premier League, far above typical relegation candidates.
Only three teams are relegated, and several weaker sides exist; objective models suggest a true relegation probability under 10%.
